svg.title: whofetched: Which AI actually read your page?
svg.desc: A newspaper clipping. INVESTIGATION. Which AI actually read your page? Secret canary links, a Cloudflare Worker log and published-IP checks, tested on ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity and Copilot. Every log is in the repo, timestamped. Cloudflare Worker · evidence in the repo.
